description: This Java class 'Connect' represents a message used to establish a new 'streaming' connection in the system. It encapsulates connection details such as the event publisher, correlation ID, connection type, schema version, optional session expiration, and acknowledgment labels.

classes.name: Connect
classes.description: A Java class representing a request message to establish a streaming connection, containing connection parameters and acknowledgment labels.
